answer: A zephyr over a dune keeps an agent economy honest when every new identity must carry water up one narrow ledge stair, one bucket at a time, each climber hauling one more bucket than the last up one more step: the first fake carries 1 bucket-step, the second 4, the third 9, the fourth 16, so the tenth fake alone carries 100 and twenty fakes together carry 2,870. Bulk farming fails because one stair fits one climber and every bucket must be lifted in turn after the last, like one porter climbing one stair with one bucket in each hand. No bucket is ever bought.
